subject: CS242
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all specified topics. The English selections are from highly-regarded channels like Neso Academy and Anita R, chosen for their clarity and massive view counts. The Arabic selections leverage the best available content, primarily from channels like AbuFatimah Alali, Abdulwahab Alhendi, and Mahmoud Essam, which provide strong coverage of these niche topics. For 'Computing Epsilon Closures' in Arabic, a video teaching it within a conversion context was chosen due to a lack of dedicated tutorials.

coverage.note: No videos specifically on Epsilon Closure. Selected best video teaching it as part of E-NFA to NFA conversion.

videos.filter_reason: An excellent, high-reach video focused specifically on the table-filling method (Myhill-Nerode), which is a common point of difficulty.
